==Fishing==
Use a [[fishnet]], a [[fishing pole]] or a [[cv:Bucket|Bucket]] to fish from the pond. The bucket hast the least success chance (6%), pole a better one (20%), using nets has the highest outcome (40%). Each fishing attempt has a five percent chance to destroy the tool used. You May get a [[cv:fish|raw fish]] which has to be brought to a [[cv:fishery|fish cleaner]]. You might also collect live animals for [[cv:cage|aquariums]].


==Notes==
* This workshop was deleted in V.5.08
